name: Wasp’s Kiss
body:
Price 26,380 gp; Slot none; CL 7th; Weight 7 lbs.; Aura moderate necromancy

DESCRIPTION

The long blade of this weapon bears shifting black and yellow patterns, resembling the markings of a wasp. This +1 heartseeker elven curve blade has three slots built into the hilt for storing doses of poison. Adding or removing a dose of poison from the blade is a swift action that requires a free hand.

Any creature struck by a wasp’s kiss suffers a –4 penalty on saving throws against the poison applied to the weapon. The frequency of any poison applied to the weapon increases by 2 (for example, black adder venom lasts 8 rounds instead of 6, and arsenic lasts for 6 minutes instead of 4). Attempts to cure the poisoned target with a skill or magic take a –4 penalty.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 13,380 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells death knell, pernicious poison
